comment: Owned by M5b. Forecast-curve accuracy, distinct from thresholds/full_output.json. The ceiling ratchets DOWN when a change is accepted and is never raised to accommodate a regression.

history.note: The harness's own starting point: predicting no drawdown at all is 100% error on every exact sample. Recorded so the first real forecaster has something to beat.

history.forecaster: build_explicit (explicit future events only, no recurrence projection)
history.note: The explicit-only baseline. The median is unchanged from the zero forecaster because 15 of the 25 samples - and 14 of the 21 exact ones - have no explicit future events at all, so their curve is flat and their drawdown is zero by construction. The mean moves from 100% to 94.2%, which is the whole contribution of every pending debit and scheduled row in the dataset. That gap is the measured size of the projection job M7b has to do: on most samples, all of it.
